Home.subtitle: A secure, multi-tenant workspace with AI that drafts and people who decide.

Goals.progressPending: No progress yet. It is calculated once linked tasks or milestones exist.

ActionErrors.invalid: Check the details and try again.

Tasks.title: Tasks
Tasks.empty: No tasks yet. Create the first one below.

Dashboard.emptyCanCreate: Nothing here yet. Start by creating your first goal.
Dashboard.empty: Nothing here yet. Goals and tasks will show up once your team creates them.

AiPlanner.title: Plan “{goal}” with AI
AiPlanner.intro: Describe what you want to achieve. The AI drafts tasks for you to review; nothing is created until you apply them.
AiPlanner.objectiveHint: Only the goal title, its description and this text are sent to the AI service.
AiPlanner.notConfigured: AI planning is not configured for this deployment. Ask an administrator to set it up.
AiPlanner.reviewIntro: Edit titles and priorities, untick what you do not want, then apply. These are suggestions, not commitments.
AiPlanner.estimateNote: Estimates are model suggestions, not guaranteed timelines.
AiPlanner.emptyDraft: This draft has no usable tasks.

Invitation.title: Join {organization}
Invitation.body: You were invited as {role}. This invitation is for {email}.
Invitation.signInFirst: Sign in (or create an account) with the invited email address, then open this link again.
Invitation.invalidBody: This invitation does not exist, was already used, was revoked, or has expired. Ask for a new one.

Chat.title: Chat
Chat.pickChannel: Pick a channel or a conversation.
Chat.readOnly: You can read this conversation but not post.

Progress.title: Progress
Progress.intro: Points recognise finished work. They are not money or a balance. Only tasks assigned to you and completed by you count, with a daily limit.
Progress.leaderboardOff: The leaderboard is turned off for this workspace.
Progress.leaderboardEmpty: Nobody has opted in with points in this period yet.
Progress.optedOut: You do not appear on the leaderboard.
Progress.policyOff: Rankings are off. Nobody sees them.
Progress.policyOptIn: Rankings are on, and only members who opted in appear.

Files.title: Files
Files.empty: No files yet. Upload the first one below.
Files.emptyReadOnly: No files have been shared with you yet.
Files.fileHint: Text, Markdown, CSV, PDF, PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 10 MB.

errors.INVALID_INPUT: Choose a non-empty file and who can see it.
errors.UNPROCESSABLE: This file cannot be stored: wrong type, over 10 MB, or the storage quota is used up.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to upload here.

Knowledge.title: Knowledge
Knowledge.intro: Search the text files that people added to the knowledge base. You only ever see passages from files you are allowed to read.
Knowledge.noResults: Nothing found in the files you can read.
Knowledge.empty: No files have been added to the knowledge base yet.
Knowledge.emptyCanManage: Nothing indexed yet. Add a text file from the Files page.

Assistant.title: Assistant
Assistant.intro: Ask a question and the assistant answers from the knowledge base files you are allowed to read, with sources. Answers can be wrong: check the sources.
Assistant.aiNote: Generated by AI from the sources below. Verify before relying on it.
Assistant.noSources: No matching passages in the files you can read, so nothing was sent to the AI.
Assistant.notConfigured: The assistant is not configured for this deployment. Ask an administrator to set it up.
Assistant.budgetLabel: Daily token budget (0 turns AI off)

Crm.title: Contacts
Crm.introAll: All contacts in this workspace. Contacts hold personal data about people outside your team: only collect what you need and record how consent was given.
Crm.introOwn: Your contacts. Contacts hold personal data about people outside your team: only collect what you need and record how consent was given.
Crm.empty: No contacts yet. Add the first one below.
Crm.name: Name
Crm.consentSourceHint: Required when consent is granted, for example “signed form” or “web form”.
Crm.erasedNotice: This contact's personal data was erased. Deals and the consent history are kept.
Crm.eraseBody: Removes the name, email, phone, company and activity text of this contact. Deals, consent proof and reports are kept. This cannot be undone.
Crm.pipelineIntro: Open deals by stage, and deals closed in the last {days} days. Values are never added across currencies.

Schedule.title: Schedule
Schedule.intro: Your meetings for the next 60 days. Times are shown and entered in your time zone ({zone}). Nobody can be double-booked: someone who has not declined counts as busy.
Schedule.empty: Nothing scheduled. Create a meeting below.
Schedule.reminderBefore: {count, plural, =1440 {1 day before} other {# min before}}
Schedule.feedIntro: Subscribe to your meetings from Google Calendar, Apple Calendar or Outlook with a private link. It is read-only and shows the meetings you attend, including titles, places and notes. Anyone who has the link can read them, so share it with nobody.
Schedule.feedShownOnce: Copy it now: it is shown only once. Creating a new link stops the old one from working.
Schedule.feedActive: A link has been active since {created}.
Schedule.feedNeverUsed: It has not been used yet.

Forms.title: Forms
Forms.intro: Collect information with a form anyone can fill in through a link. Forms that create contacts ask the visitor to accept a consent statement, and that acceptance is recorded.
Forms.empty: No forms yet. Start from a template below.
Forms.publicLink: Anyone with this link can submit the form:
Forms.draftNote: Not public yet. Publishing makes the link work.
Forms.closedNote: Closed. The link no longer works; you can publish it again.
Forms.consentHint: What visitors agree to. It can only change while the form is a draft.
Forms.fieldsDraft: Add, remove, reorder and change fields while the form is a draft. Visitors see the wording exactly as saved here.
Forms.fieldsLabelsOnly: The form has been published, so only the labels can change. This keeps stored answers matching their fields.
Forms.fieldsContactNote: Forms that create contacts keep a required name and email.

PublicForm.privacy: Your answers are sent to the organization that published this form.
PublicForm.thanks: Thank you! Your answers were sent.

Insights.title: Insights
Insights.intro: Counts for the last {days} days compared with the {days} days before. These are totals only: no names, answers or meeting titles appear here.
Insights.meetingsScope: Only meetings you organize or attend are counted.

Booking.title: Booking pages
Booking.intro: Let visitors book a free slot with you from a public link. Slots come from your weekly hours minus your other meetings. Each booking creates or links a CRM contact, records their consent, and appears in your schedule. Only you can see and manage your pages.
Booking.empty: No booking pages yet. Create one below.
Booking.zoneLabel: Time zone of your working hours
Booking.consentDefault: I agree that you may store these details and contact me about this meeting.
Booking.consentHint: Visitors must accept this before booking, and it cannot change once the page has been published.
Booking.googleIntro: Connect your Google Calendar so booking pages skip times when you are busy. Only your busy times are read, never event titles or details, and nothing from your calendar is stored.
Booking.googleNotConfigured: Google Calendar is not set up on this server.
Booking.googleConnected: Connected on {date}. Your booking pages avoid times when you are busy in Google Calendar.
Booking.googleNeedsReconnect: Google no longer accepts this connection. Your booking pages show no times until you reconnect or disconnect.

googleResult.denied: Google Calendar was not connected: the permission to see when you are busy was not granted.
googleResult.failed: Google Calendar could not be connected. Please try again.

Booking.publicLink: Anyone with this link can book a time with you:
Booking.draftNote: Not public yet. Publish the page to share its link.
Booking.closedNote: The link no longer works. Publish again to reopen it.

PublicBooking.noSlots: There are no free times right now. Please check back later.
PublicBooking.unavailable: Booking is temporarily unavailable. Please check back later.
PublicBooking.name: Your name
PublicBooking.booked: You are booked for {time}. Thank you!
PublicBooking.bookedGeneric: Thank you! Your request was sent.
PublicBooking.privacy: Your details are sent to the organization that published this page.

Billing.title: Plan and usage
Billing.unmeteredNote: This workspace has no plan limits.
Billing.trialExpired: The trial has ended; the workspace is on the Free plan.
Billing.changePlan: Plans are changed by the platform operator for now. Contact them to move to another plan.
Billing.seatsNote: Inviting someone reserves a seat until the invitation is accepted, revoked or expired.
Billing.aiNote: When the daily or monthly AI allowance is used up, AI features pause until it resets (UTC). There is no overage billing.
Billing.downgradeNote: Moving to a smaller plan never deletes data. Existing contacts, files and members stay readable; adding more is blocked once a limit is reached, and public links stop answering when the plan does not include them.

Admin.title: Operator console
Admin.intro: Cross-workspace operations. Every change here is written to that workspace's audit trail. Only counts and workspace names are shown, never member content.
Admin.usage: {members} active members · {tokens} AI tokens this month
Admin.limit: Showing at most {count} workspaces; narrow the search to find others.
